steps.text: Mrs Bride's time of death was late yesterday evening, after the maid had locked the door.
The manor is heavily guarded, surrounded by the lake on three sides, with high walls between the water and the manor.
It is simply impossible for an outsider to break in unnoticed.
Therefore...
The killer is right here, among us!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: R-Really, Miss Metis?

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: There's a killer among us? That can't be!

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: Poppycock! Ridiculous!

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: I take it that you've found the evidence to implicate the killer?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Huh? Er, well...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Ahem, o-of course I have!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: First, according to the maid's testimony, an Originium ornament that was supposed to be in the bedroom went missing after the incident.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: The victim's injuries indicate that this was likely the weapon!

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: You don't mean to say whoever is carrying the weapon is the killer, do you?

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: I doubt anyone would carry something like that on their person.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Quiet while I'm deducing!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Of course, that's not the only thing! Here's the second point: The scene of the crime is very messy, with a large amount of blood on the victim's face and hands.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Madam Bride suffered a large number of wounds on her body, in addition to the fatal wound on her head. Do you understand what this means, Miss Heidi?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: It means... there was a struggle between the killer and the victim?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Exactly! A bloody one too!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: At that distance, it was inevitable that the killer would have gotten blood on them!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Therefore, whoever has got blood on them must be the killer!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: How's that!

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: What a load of rubbish! No one here's got any blood on them!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Huh? B-But...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: How could that be? It's impossible... one of us must be the killer!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Just how stupid are you?

steps.name: May
steps.text: W-Why are you stooping to insults? What have I done to you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's not an insult, it's the truth.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I wasn't expecting much out of your first case, but that deduction's got more holes than a sieve.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm afraid... so.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: See, Anna's with me.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Et tu, Istina?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: After what I've just heard, it is inevitable.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The logic is sound, in a vacuum, but there's no way that a killer would appear wearing blood-soaked clothes. They would try to destroy any evidence.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anyone with a brain would.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I guess... that makes sense.

steps.name: May
steps.text: The killer wasn't dumb enough to walk around covered in blood, and the witnesses were sure they didn't see anyone bloodied in the manor.

steps.name: May
steps.text: I had taken this into account, of course. Therefore—

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: You checked all our belongings. There were no bloody clothes!

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: Enough of this farce, Miss Metis Geraldine!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: T-That can't be! I must have missed it...

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: The results are here for all of us to see, Miss Metis.

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: Not a one of us is holding anything suspicious.

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: Isn't it time to hand this case over to the police? We really must be going.

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Yes, too much time has been wasted here already.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Wait! Just give me a little bit longer!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I'll find the clues and catch the killer! I swear it!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Please, just a little more time...

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Well... what do you think, Miss Heidi?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I would beg your patience for just a little longer.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Miss Heidi! Thank you so much...

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Do you really believe the killer is among us, Miss Heidi?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I have every faith in your character, and that of everyone else present. Which is why we should allow our detective here to prove our collective innocence.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: What would people outside say if we left now and the police were unable to solve the case?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The rumor mill may not be so rational.

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: Very well, if you say so.

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: And I want to see what this self-proclaimed detective can do!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: W-Who are you calling self-proclaimed?!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I mean, sure, it's the first time I've faced a case like this... but I'll solve it!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: That piece of Gloompincer dung...

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Don't let it get to you, Miss Metis, we all believe in you.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Thank you, Mr. Hull!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Mr Hull, you have a mismatched jacket and necktie.

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: I-Is that so? How embarrassing. The maid must have brought me the wrong jacket.

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Anyway, I won't take up any more of your time. I look forward to good news.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Alright, snap out of it.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Sir William might have been a little brusque, but he was reasonably cooperative.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Do you suspect him to be the killer?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Not really...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I've identified a more likely suspect.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Setting that aside for a moment... any updates on what I asked, Miss Heidi?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I didn't find anything in the rooms. No clues regarding the killer at all. You, the client, are the only one I can trust!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: You have the honor of being my first assistant ever!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: It's an honor. I suppose.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But did you consider the possibility that the client could be the killer?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: What? O-Of course, I've considered it!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I haven't let my guard down, just because you had an alibi!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: It's a trick that detectives use to get suspects to let their guard down... yes, that's it!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Hehe. Well then, I'd better work harder to clear my name.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Would you like to hear my report?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Yes, straight away!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: What did you find? Did anyone sneak into the kitchen or use the fireplace? Or perhaps somewhere else a fire could be lit?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: As far as I can tell, no.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The kitchens were being watched by the servants and they didn't see anyone. No sign of fires being lit in the fireplaces in the rooms. Nothing was destroyed by fire.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: So, no clues at all?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: The killer would not keep such a clue with them. They would try to destroy it at the first opportunity. Fire would be the safest way to do so.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Could it be... Originium Arts?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: A skilled caster could destroy evidence by conjuring flames out of nothing. That would make it impossible to find a clue.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Or not... it was an Originium ornament. Those things don't burn so easily. There must be some trace.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But we've searched the entire manor.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: And there was nothing.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: How am I supposed to solve this case if I can't even find the murder weapon?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Is this too much for me to crack?)

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Are you giving up?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: O-Of course I'm not giving up!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I'm just...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Do you think it's hopeless? That the evidence must have been destroyed?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: It's true that I wasn't able to find any clues...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Miss Heidi must be disappointed.)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Oh no, the tears are starting to flow... please stop!)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I-I'm sorry, Miss Heidi, I, I could find a more experienced detective if you're not satisfied with my performance.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: But p-please just give me a little more time.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I, I'll get to the bottom of this... please don't fire me! *wails*

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: I never said I was firing you.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: You may be inexperienced, but I see potential in your determined search for clues.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: There must be a way, even if we might be missing some evidence.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: After all, the truth is always there. It never changes.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: The truth's always there...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Any crime must leave a trail...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: A great detective won't let herself get frustrated so easily.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: B-But I'm just a no-name detective, and this is my first big case... I... I...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I don't know if I can do this on my own.

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Say, what happened to the confident young detective I hired?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Besides, you're not alone.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Didn't you say I was your first assistant?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Or are you taking it back so hastily?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Miss Heidiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Yes! I'll become a household name, and everyone will know that you were my first assistant!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't be so harsh, Sonya. It's just a little bit much for the dinner table.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's basically what I meant, yeah.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The fat guy did it. Why are we even talking about this?

steps.name: May
steps.text: You're all the same!

steps.name: May
steps.text: This was the second most touching scene of my first case! The detective and her assistant! The assistant comforting the detective in her darkest hour...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Isn't it touching?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Er... well, sure, I suppose so.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The interaction between the detective and his assistant is certainly one of the selling points of many mystery novels. Classics of the genre set these two characters up to contrast with each other.

steps.name: May
steps.text: See? Hehe...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Not sure if a mystery novel would work with a detective like this, though.)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Okay, let's forget this first assistant you never saw again. Didn't you call Skyfire your seventh assistant last time?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: She almost set you on fire for that. A couple words of encouragement, and you're falling head over heels.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hmph! You don't understand the detective-assistant dynamic at all!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, whatever. Just get this over with.

steps.name: May
steps.text: After that, it was the Metis Show, of course...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: The scene of the crime looks the same.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (We've searched it many times. Another sweep won't yield any clues.)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (We should look somewhere else.)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Nothing here... don't suppose anyone would leave bloody evidence out in the open.)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Ouch!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: My head...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (No, nothing here either.)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (I must have missed something... but where could it be?)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Did they really destroy all the evidence?)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: No, that can't be!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Any crime must leave a trail. They won't fool me!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (This is the last area. If there's nothing here...)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Could the killer really have committed a crime without leaving a trail?)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (What's that outside the window?)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (The lake outside the manor?)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: (Wait, if it's visible from here, it must be visible from the scene of the crime!)

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: This must be the place!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I knew it!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: This room is higher than the wall, and the window faces the lake!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I've got it...

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Give me a second... whew. What happened, Miss Metis? Why did you...?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Miss Heidi!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Ah, I'm here?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I found it! I found the clue!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: It wasn't fire, it was water!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: That's where the evidence must be... over there!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: The lake?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: Do you mean that the killer threw the bloody clothes into the lake?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: And we didn't search outside the manor!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Let me guess, you want to say that they couldn't have thrown their clothes such a distance, right?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: But clothes aren't the only thing we're looking for!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: We're also looking for the murder weapon!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Why didn't anyone see the bloody clothes? Because the killer didn't leave the scene wearing them!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Why didn't we find the weapon? Because the killer wrapped the bloody clothes around it and threw it into the lake!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: This explains everything!

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: But finding the killer won't be easy, if they indeed threw all the evidence into the lake.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Just because it's not easy doesn't mean it's impossible!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I'll find the clues and the killer, no matter what it takes!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Why the face?! This is the climactic moment!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Where's the applause? Where's the praise?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Slow clap)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And then what happened?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't tell me that's the end.

steps.name: May
steps.text: O-Of course not! After that, it was the Metis Show...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We heard that part already.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Enough nitpicking! Do you find some fault with my detective adventure?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Now then, the ending—

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: This is quite enough. When can we leave?

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: This is absurd! I refuse to entertain this little girl's detective games any longer!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Miss Metis, I don't think we can proceed without any evidence.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hehehe...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hehe, hehehe, hahahaha!

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: Wh-What are you laughing at?

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I'm laughing at the foolish killer, who still thinks they can escape me, and justice.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: A criminal always leaves a trail, and it's up to a detective to find it.

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: And I'm happy to say that I've found the evidence!

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: I present you the decisive evidence implicating the killer!

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: T-This is the jacket Mr. Hull wore yesterday! Why is it all wet?

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: Are those bloodstains?

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: And the Originum ornament... is this the murder weapon?

steps.name: Heidi
steps.text: That seems decisive. How do you explain this, Mr. Hull?

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Th-This is all a big misunderstanding!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: I, I just... er...

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: No more excuses!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: This is what you get for underestimating me! The evidence is clear! There's nowhere to run!

steps.name: Noblewoman
steps.text: My goodness, Miss Metis... how did you manage this?

steps.name: Wealthy Man
steps.text: Hmph, looks like you're not all talk after all!

steps.name: Noblewoman and Wealthy Man
steps.text: You're an outstanding detective!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: And I would have gotten away with it too, if it weren't for this meddling detective!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: But you'll have to catch me first!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Not so fast!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Plump Merchant
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Hands up! No sudden moves!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: There's no such thing as an unsolvable mystery when I'm on the case!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: Mr. Hull!

steps.name: Metis
steps.text: You, sir, are the true culprit!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's your ending?!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're skipping right to the killer reveal? What kind of ending is that? And you just made up everyone else's lines, didn't you?

steps.name: May
steps.text: W-What gave you that idea? They were all remarkably impressed with my detective work... it's only natural!

steps.name: May
steps.text: That's quite enough, Zima! I won't stand for such an attack on a detective of renown!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ha. If you're a 'detective of renown,' then I'm the new sheriff in town.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The first half was okay, but your ending is even worse than 'The Death of Ilyich, the Suspect'...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Hmph! Some people just can't appreciate a good story!

steps.name: May
steps.text: But you're not one of them, are you, Istina?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya may have been a little too harsh, but it's definitely missing some important details.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: For example, the killer wrapped the bloody clothes around the heavy Originium ornament, making sure that the evidence would sink to the bottom of the lake.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Yes, that's right!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And it's not so easy to dredge up evidence from the bottom of a lake.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Well, er... it did take some time... I spent days digging through the mud, and we finally found the evidence with the help of the police...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So they didn't need you at all.

steps.name: May
steps.text: It was I who found the clue! And I dug through the mud for three straight days! I found the evidence with my own hands!

steps.name: May
steps.text: We got the killer in the end! What's a couple of days more or less?!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That's not all.

steps.name: May
steps.text: W-What else?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The evidence happened to be preserved in the form of bloody clothing and a weapon this time. But what would you do if the culprit actually destroyed the evidence using Originium Arts?

steps.name: May
steps.text: Er... well, that happens from time to time...

steps.name: May
steps.text: The police have tools for investigating crimes by Arts users.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So they didn't need you at all.

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh, stuff it!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: At least the premise was interesting. Foolish detective and clever assistant.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Did you ever see Heidi again?

steps.name: May
steps.text: What do you mean by 'at least?'

steps.name: May
steps.text: Soon after, I encountered that suspicious penguin, so I went undercover to pursue him...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Er, actually, never mind that.

steps.name: May
steps.text: (Forget the undercover stuff...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (You're still trying to hide it?)

steps.name: May
steps.text: Ahem. Anyway, I never saw Miss Heidi again.

steps.name: May
steps.text: But I'm sure my first assistant is still out there, and doing well.

steps.name: May
steps.text: And we'll see each other again when I become a household name!

steps.name: May
steps.text: But to do that...

steps.name: May
steps.text: I'll have to catch that fat penguin with the gold chain!
